messages.title: PulseDeck 0.1.2 is available
messages.body:
A new universal PulseDeck build is ready. This release improves onboarding, Home recommendations, streaming shuffle, playlist and album playback continuity, Listening Insights, connection handling, and overall reliability.

Visit the PulseDeck Telegram channel to download the APK. Install it over your current official build to retain your app data.

messages.title: PulseDeck Version 0.1.2 is out now
messages.body: Download the latest Apk on telegram
